blocks.content: In the classroom scheduling problem, we were dealing with one solitary variable—time—which made things very simple.
But here, we have two variables:

items: the value of the content inside it to consider.

blocks.content: What if we could combine the weight and value variables to get a singular unit of measurement?
Since our goal is to get the most value for a given weight, it's better to consider the value per unit of each item to grab greedily instead of considering both weight and value.
So our logic to solve the problem would be:

items: Get the value/unit of each item.
Fit the maximum contents of the item with the highest value/unit in the knapsack.
If there's still space remaining, repeat step 2 with the item with the next highest value/unit.
